description: A production starting point: as the pilot, but a rule change waits 24 h before it applies, so the supervisory authority can veto it (DECISIONS.md D19). Requiring the supervisory authority on every revocation (component 10.2's alternative) is "requiredRoles": ["C"] under revoke. Every role may veto; "vetoRoles" narrows that, so one compromised key of another role cannot stop every decision (DECISIONS.md D21).
